contentText: US President Donald Trump announced on Saturday that Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has been captured after the US conducted a "large-scale strike" on the country. Maduro had declared a state of emergency earlier in the day, accusing the United States of a “very serious military aggression” after multiple explosions and aircraft-like sounds were reported across the capital Caracas. France24 journalist Shirli Sitbon explains further.
